development_basis: All 64 newly generated tone controls were negative after desktop nuisance fitting, removing six raw flags while preserving development RF detections and recovering tone-contaminated RF evidence. It is not a fresh RF holdout or a specificity qualification.
scope: Separately named stationary-tone-conditioned differential detector. Caller IQ remains unchanged, but final fractional GLRT uses the conditioned full-20ms working signal when a fit is applied; this must be reported.
algorithm_changes: One 4096/8192-point snapshot FFT tests a fixed 2% three-bin spectral fraction. Integer lag phases at 256,4096,16384 samples refine one tone. Apply its least-squares subtraction only when fitted power exceeds 1% of whole-probe power.
A periodically re-anchored oscillator recurrence replaces per-sample trigonometry in the native fit. Compare its results with the NumPy fit before interpreting timing.
No score threshold or reference association tolerance changes. Existing result and profile wire schemas remain unchanged; nuisance diagnostics use a separate optional schema.
